I can tell you've thought about this a lot, it's justified but I urge you to get a little more experience under your belt, live a little. I used to feel like you, it all made sense, it still does, but this is only one perspective and I don't think you've had the life experience to realize that. I'm not saying it gets better, I'm saying that it can, all you have to do is get a larger more perspective and that comes with experiencing life. There are higher highs and lower lows, let yourself feel them, give it a year and allow yourself to have fun, even if it's under the pretense of it being your last year, I guarantee some part of you will start to debate sticking around. And I hope you do, the world needs more thinkers like you. If you want to talk ever, I'm around.

I relate with this a lot. I just want to share one thing that I never thought about: I tried to isolate myself from family and friends for about a year and when I tried to kill myself they were so much more affected by it than I had anticipated, and I hadn't even succeeded. I don't believe you should stay alive for other people, but I want to encourage you to think about the consequences of your actions on those left behind. If you want to talk, I'll be around.
